label: final1
frozen_at: 2026-11-15 about 04:55 PST, before any final1 episode was generated
purpose: Frozen final run for the 'beat Genie 3 (2.12)' goal: stock vs one method arm (static text director) on all 171 PlayWorld cases.
hardware: Lambda Cloud gpu_1x_h100_pcie (H100 80 GB), one warm worker per instance

code.note: the run uses the commit that adds this file (reported to the coordinator); worldsync/ is identical to parent_commit

model: LingBot-World2 14B causal-fast, stock weights, 18/6 window, 480x832, 16 FPS, BF16, sdpa attention, no quantization
player: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (reference-guided player, END challenge, --player-retries 2), reached through the local Claude proxy over an SSH reverse tunnel

director.flags: the stock flags of the split plus --director static --director-text-file reproduction/director-static-texts-all.json
director.gc: DEFINED as identical to stock (stock text). The director arm's GC episodes ARE the stock arm's GC episodes; they are not regenerated, so the GC delta is zero by construction.
director.texts: reproduction/director-static-texts-all.json: one static world-model text per case written by claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 through worldsync.lingbot_director.Director from image_caption, prompt and action_sequence_steps only (no images, questions, policies, rubric or judge text); 0 LLM errors; no director LLM call at run time.

job_list: reproduction/final-run-jobs.jsonl (294 jobs: 171 stock + 123 director; arms and dimensions interleaved; the 20 development cases last). A job is done when <output>/run.json has status completed; transient failures are retried by the worker.
deviations_from_the_modal_full_run_full1: Hardware: Lambda H100 PCIe instead of Modal H200 (outputs are bit-exact only within one GPU model), so the stock arm is regenerated here and compared with the director arm on the same hardware.
Reference-plan parser fix d484e0f (pitch keys u/j map to UP/DOWN); applies to both arms; affects 7 plans (GC008, GC016, OE028, OE030, OE032, OE036, OE047).
Player calls go through the local Claude proxy (same model id) because the project API key reached its usage limit.
Insight uses --text-prompt caption at 60 chunks (the full1 amendment), other splits --text-prompt both.

analysis_preregistered.judge: released PlayWorld rubric, instruction gate and aggregation via Vertex gemini-3.1-pro-preview (gcloud login); neutral world-model name, the arm is never shown to the judge
analysis_preregistered.primary: ONE Gemini call per episode. Per-dimension mean; overall = equal mean of the four dimension means (GC, IF, insight, out-of-sight); bootstrap 95% CI resampling cases within each dimension; paired director-minus-stock difference per case with bootstrap CI.
reported_sets: each of those with and without GC013 (released image contradicts its caption and rubric)
analysis_preregistered.secondary: mean of 3 independent Gemini calls per episode for both arms, if time allows; labelled secondary
analysis_preregistered.unscorable_episodes: listed with the reason and excluded from both arms' pairs; generation failures listed and never imputed
analysis_preregistered.success_criterion: reproduction/pass-criterion.md, unchanged: the claim 'beats 2.12' needs the director arm's overall on all 171 cases above 2.12 with the lower CI bound above 2.12; a point estimate above 2.12 with a CI that includes 2.12 is reported as 'point estimate only, not established'.

prediction_on_record.source: 20 development cases, fixed-action replays, mean of 3 judge calls (reproduction/director-dev.md)

dev_paired_deltas.gc: -0.44 [-1.33, +1.33] n=3 (director not applied to GC in this run)

prediction_on_record.projected_overall: about 2.05 for the director arm (stock about 1.85 + 0.20) if the dev deltas transfer exactly; they came from a few judge calls, so smaller is more likely
prediction_on_record.odds: point estimate above 2.12: roughly one in four at best; lower CI bound above 2.12: essentially ruled out (the 171-case overall CI half-width is about 0.18)
